ar: السجدة
en: Sura 32: As-Sajdah

p.src: 32:1  Alif Lām Mīm[1].

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ
en: Alif Lām Mīm[1].
u.src: 32:1  Alif Lām Mīm[1].

en: [1] See footnote 2:1.

p.src: 32:2  The revelation of the Book, about which there is no doubt, is from the Lord of the worlds.

ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
en: The revelation of the Book, about which there is no doubt, is from the Lord of the worlds.
u.src: 32:2  The revelation of the Book, about which there is no doubt, is from the Lord of the worlds.

p.src: 32:3  Or do they say, “He has fabricated it.”? No, it is the truth from your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you, in order that they may be guided.

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
en: Or do they say, “He has fabricated it.”? No, it is the truth from your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you, in order that they may be guided.
u.src: 32:3  Or do they say, “He has fabricated it.”? No, it is the truth from your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you, in order that they may be guided.

p.src: 32:4  It is Allah Who created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six Days, then rose over the Throne[2]. You have no protector or intercessor other than Him. Will you not then take heed?

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
en: It is Allah Who created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six Days, then rose over the Throne[2]. You have no protector or intercessor other than Him. Will you not then take heed?
u.src: 32:4  It is Allah Who created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six Days, then rose over the Throne[2]. You have no protector or intercessor other than Him. Will you not then take heed?

en: [2] See footnote 7:54.

p.src: 32:5  He manages every matter from the heaven to the earth, then everything ascends to Him on a Day the length of which is a thousand years by your reckoning.

ar: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
en: He manages every matter from the heaven to the earth, then everything ascends to Him on a Day the length of which is a thousand years by your reckoning.
u.src: 32:5  He manages every matter from the heaven to the earth, then everything ascends to Him on a Day the length of which is a thousand years by your reckoning.

p.src: 32:6  Such is the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen, the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

ar: ذَٰلِكَ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: Such is the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen, the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,
u.src: 32:6  Such is the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen, the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

p.src: 32:7  Who perfected everything He created, and initiated the creation of man[3] from clay.

ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ مِن طِينٍ
en: Who perfected everything He created, and initiated the creation of man[3] from clay.
u.src: 32:7  Who perfected everything He created, and initiated the creation of man[3] from clay.

en: [3] i.e., the creation of Adam in an unprecedented manner.

p.src: 32:8  Then He made his progeny from the extract of a worthless fluid.

ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُۥ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
en: Then He made his progeny from the extract of a worthless fluid.
u.src: 32:8  Then He made his progeny from the extract of a worthless fluid.

p.src: 32:9  Then He fashioned him and breathed into him of His spirit[4]. He granted you hearing, sight and intellect; yet little it is that you give thanks.

ar: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
en: Then He fashioned him and breathed into him of His spirit[4]. He granted you hearing, sight and intellect; yet little it is that you give thanks.
u.src: 32:9  Then He fashioned him and breathed into him of His spirit[4]. He granted you hearing, sight and intellect; yet little it is that you give thanks.

en: [4] i.e., which is an element of life.

p.src: 32:10  They say, “What! Is it that when we are disintegrated into the earth, will we then be created anew?” Rather, they deny the meeting with their Lord.

ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
en: They say, “What! Is it that when we are disintegrated into the earth, will we then be created anew?” Rather, they deny the meeting with their Lord.
u.src: 32:10  They say, “What! Is it that when we are disintegrated into the earth, will we then be created anew?” Rather, they deny the meeting with their Lord.

p.src: 32:11  Say, “The angel of death, who is in charge of you, will take your souls, then to your Lord you will be brought back.”

ar: قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱلَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: Say, “The angel of death, who is in charge of you, will take your souls, then to your Lord you will be brought back.”
u.src: 32:11  Say, “The angel of death, who is in charge of you, will take your souls, then to your Lord you will be brought back.”

p.src: 32:12  If only you could see the wicked lowering their heads before their Lord, “Our Lord, we have now seen and heard. Send us back; we will do righteous deeds. Now we truly have faith.”

ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
en: If only you could see the wicked lowering their heads before their Lord, “Our Lord, we have now seen and heard. Send us back; we will do righteous deeds. Now we truly have faith.”
u.src: 32:12  If only you could see the wicked lowering their heads before their Lord, “Our Lord, we have now seen and heard. Send us back; we will do righteous deeds. Now we truly have faith.”

p.src: 32:13  If We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but My Word[5] will be fulfilled: “I will certainly fill up Hell with jinn and men all together.”

ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَـَٔاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: If We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but My Word[5] will be fulfilled: “I will certainly fill up Hell with jinn and men all together.”
u.src: 32:13  If We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but My Word[5] will be fulfilled: “I will certainly fill up Hell with jinn and men all together.”

en: [5] That the evildoers deserve.

p.src: 32:14  So taste [the punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. We have likewise forgotten you. Taste the eternal punishment for what you used to do.”

ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَـٰكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: So taste [the punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. We have likewise forgotten you. Taste the eternal punishment for what you used to do.”
u.src: 32:14  So taste [the punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. We have likewise forgotten you. Taste the eternal punishment for what you used to do.”

p.src: 32:15  The true believers in Our verses are only those who, when they are reminded of them, fall in prostration and glorify their Lord with praise, and they do not show arrogance.

ar: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهَا خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا۟ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۩
en: The true believers in Our verses are only those who, when they are reminded of them, fall in prostration and glorify their Lord with praise, and they do not show arrogance.
u.src: 32:15  The true believers in Our verses are only those who, when they are reminded of them, fall in prostration and glorify their Lord with praise, and they do not show arrogance.

p.src: 32:16  They forsake their beds, invoking their Lord with fear and hope, and spend[6] out of what We have provided for them.

ar: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
en: They forsake their beds, invoking their Lord with fear and hope, and spend[6] out of what We have provided for them.
u.src: 32:16  They forsake their beds, invoking their Lord with fear and hope, and spend[6] out of what We have provided for them.

en: [6] In the way of Allah.

p.src: 32:17  No soul knows what delights are kept hidden for them as a reward for what they used to do.

ar: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أُخْفِىَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: No soul knows what delights are kept hidden for them as a reward for what they used to do.
u.src: 32:17  No soul knows what delights are kept hidden for them as a reward for what they used to do.

p.src: 32:18  Is one who is a believer like one who is an evildoer? They are not equal.

ar: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُۥنَ
en: Is one who is a believer like one who is an evildoer? They are not equal.
u.src: 32:18  Is one who is a believer like one who is an evildoer? They are not equal.

p.src: 32:19  As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, they will have gardens to dwell in, as an accommodation for what they used to do.

ar: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, they will have gardens to dwell in, as an accommodation for what they used to do.
u.src: 32:19  As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, they will have gardens to dwell in, as an accommodation for what they used to do.

p.src: 32:20  But those who are rebellious, their abode will be the Fire. Every time they try to escape from it, they will be driven back into it, and it will be said to them, “Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny.”

ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا۟ فَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
en: But those who are rebellious, their abode will be the Fire. Every time they try to escape from it, they will be driven back into it, and it will be said to them, “Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny.”
u.src: 32:20  But those who are rebellious, their abode will be the Fire. Every time they try to escape from it, they will be driven back into it, and it will be said to them, “Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny.”

p.src: 32:21  We will certainly make them taste some minor punishment[7] prior to the greater punishment[8], so that they may return.

ar: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
en: We will certainly make them taste some minor punishment[7] prior to the greater punishment[8], so that they may return.
u.src: 32:21  We will certainly make them taste some minor punishment[7] prior to the greater punishment[8], so that they may return.

en:
[7] i.e., the calamities and trials in this world.
 [8] In the Hereafter.

p.src: 32:22  Who does greater wrong than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord, then turns away from them? We will surely take vengeance upon the wicked.

ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَآ ۚ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ
en: Who does greater wrong than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord, then turns away from them? We will surely take vengeance upon the wicked.
u.src: 32:22  Who does greater wrong than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord, then turns away from them? We will surely take vengeance upon the wicked.

p.src: 32:23  We gave Moses the Scripture, so do not doubt about meeting him[9], and We made it a guide for the Children of Israel.

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
en: We gave Moses the Scripture, so do not doubt about meeting him[9], and We made it a guide for the Children of Israel.
u.src: 32:23  We gave Moses the Scripture, so do not doubt about meeting him[9], and We made it a guide for the Children of Israel.

en: [9] i.e., so do not doubt, O Muhammad, about meeting Moses on the night of al-Mi‘rāj (ascent).

p.src: 32:24  We made some of them leaders[10], guiding by Our command, because they observed patience and firmly believed in Our signs.

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
en: We made some of them leaders[10], guiding by Our command, because they observed patience and firmly believed in Our signs.
u.src: 32:24  We made some of them leaders[10], guiding by Our command, because they observed patience and firmly believed in Our signs.

en: [10] i.e., prophets and religious leaders.

p.src: 32:25  Indeed, it is your Lord Who will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
en: Indeed, it is your Lord Who will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
u.src: 32:25  Indeed, it is your Lord Who will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

p.src: 32:26  Is it not yet clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, in whose dwellings they now walk about? Indeed, there are signs in this. Do they not then listen?

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ ۖ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ
en: Is it not yet clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, in whose dwellings they now walk about? Indeed, there are signs in this. Do they not then listen?
u.src: 32:26  Is it not yet clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, in whose dwellings they now walk about? Indeed, there are signs in this. Do they not then listen?

p.src: 32:27  Do they not see that We drive water to parched land, producing thereby crops of which their cattle and they themselves eat? Do they not then see?

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَـٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ
en: Do they not see that We drive water to parched land, producing thereby crops of which their cattle and they themselves eat? Do they not then see?
u.src: 32:27  Do they not see that We drive water to parched land, producing thereby crops of which their cattle and they themselves eat? Do they not then see?

p.src: 32:28  They say, “When will this Decision[11] be if you are truthful?”

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
en: They say, “When will this Decision[11] be if you are truthful?”
u.src: 32:28  They say, “When will this Decision[11] be if you are truthful?”

en: [11] i.e., judgment on the Day of Resurrection.

p.src: 32:29  Say, “On the Day of Decision the belief of those who disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be given any respite.”

ar: قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
en: Say, “On the Day of Decision the belief of those who disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be given any respite.”
u.src: 32:29  Say, “On the Day of Decision the belief of those who disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be given any respite.”

p.src: 32:30  So turn away from them and wait; they too are waiting.

ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَٱنتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ
en: So turn away from them and wait; they too are waiting.
u.src: 32:30  So turn away from them and wait; they too are waiting.
